reviews.comment:
Una pena! Paramos a cargar agua caliente para el termo y nos quisieron cobrar $50. A 15 km la Estación YPF Ruta 12 Km 1037 dan el agua GRATIS. Deberían aprender a dar un buen servicio en el ACA.

(Translated by Google)
What a shame! We stopped to get hot water for the thermos and they wanted to charge us $50. Just 15 km away, the YPF station at Km 1037 on Route 12 gives you water for FREE. They should learn how to provide good service at the ACA (Automobile Club of Argentina).
